name: Boku to Nakadashi Onna Kyoushi ~Sensei no Naka wa Seieki Mamire~
original_name: ぼくと子宮（なか）出し女教師　～先生の中は精液まみれ～
source:
Masahiro transfers to a boarding school. On his first day of new school, he is mistakenly treated as an underwear thief. And he is told that a school dorm is closed down. After all, he starts to live at a teacher dorm. There are only three female teachers, who think him as an underwear thief, and one female student living there. Also, they need to cook meals and clean by themselves, and he is treated like a slave by them. But one day, he catches a real underwear thief, and relationships between Masahiro and teachers start to change....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090201063613/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005674]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
正宏转学到一所寄宿学校。开学第一天，他被误认为是内衣小偷。他被告知学校宿舍已关闭。毕竟，他开始住在教师宿舍。住在那里的只有三名女老师和一名女学生，他们认为他是内衣贼。而且还要他们自己做饭、打扫卫生，而他却被他们当成了奴隶。但有一天，他抓住了一名真正的内衣小偷，正宏和老师之间的关系开始发生变化……
